title: Einstein's deathbed breakthrough

tellings.quote: there's a saying that on his deathbed he suddenly became ecstatic and was started talking excitedly to his nurse in German.

plain: There is a saying that when the physicist Albert Einstein was dying in Princeton, New Jersey, in 1955, he suddenly became ecstatic and began talking excitedly to his nurse in German, as if he had just made a breakthrough. The physicist John Brandenburg passes this on to Michels as something people say, not as something he saw. The story matters because the nurse did not speak German, so whatever Einstein may have worked out would have been lost.
